title: Console: nav action dispatch reads an action by bare name, so a name two packages hold toasts "Could not load action"
body:
domain:server#4 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi1tLRTEYwYGtbNCyk

Carrier filed from contract review 6781770671 on PR #32361 (card #32244, ③, not flagged by the dev). For the ui lane. Child of the ADR-0150 epic #31527.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavActionDispatch.ts:68` calls `getItem('action', actionName)` with no package. Once #32361 merges, a bare read of an action name two enabled packages hold answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`. In both packages' apps, the nav action then toasts "Could not load action".

**Governing text:** ADR-0150 D5 has the Console pass the package it holds, and row E2 resolves an `ActionNavItem` by D3 from its package. The server address exists (`?package=` and the qualified path); the consumer does not use it.

**Fix:** pass the nav item's owning package on the read. Pin a two-package name where each app opens its own action.

**Reach:** first-party count is 0 today (no shipped app pair shares an action name). Any two installed packages that do share one hit it.

**Re-check:** `grep -n "getItem('action'" ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavActionDispatch.ts`.

**Serial:** after #32361 (#32244) merges.
